verse.text: Don’t let anyone think less of you because you are young. Be an example to all believers in what you say, in the way you live, in your love, your faith, and your purity.

video.title: 1 Timothy 4:12 | Youth—Setting an Example | Bible Devotional

reflection: Your kids aren't waiting for you to have it all figured out before they start watching — they're watching now, in how you talk, how you treat their mom, and how you handle a bad day. Paul's charge to Timothy applies just as much to dads: you don't earn the right to lead by your age or title, but by living out speech, love, faith, and integrity in front of the people who matter most. Small, consistent example beats a perfect speech every time.
